# optimism.fun

> optimism.fun is an open-source research and navigation project that ranks major unsolved problems and connects them to evidence, organizations, founders, capital, and measurable progress.

Canonical site: https://optimism.fun/
Project identity: optimism.fun
Operator credits: built by Adam Pangelinan; Anchor Marianas LLC is included in the site's operator credits.
Source repository: https://github.com/adamtpang/optimism.fun

## Use this site when

- Comparing the published set of large unsolved problems across welfare, existential-risk, utility, urgency, demand, supply, and capital-allocation lenses.
- Finding cited organizations, founders, allocators, public companies, countries, source material, and progress indicators connected to a problem.
- Understanding the project's methodology, confidence labels, data freshness, and acknowledged coverage gaps before quoting a score.

## Key pages

- Homepage and ranked problem index: https://optimism.fun/
- Methodology and scoring limits: https://optimism.fun/methodology
- Problem opportunity radar: https://optimism.fun/radar
- Companies and solutions: https://optimism.fun/companies
- Founders and people: https://optimism.fun/founders
- Capital and allocators: https://optimism.fun/ecosystem
- Evidence of progress: https://optimism.fun/progress
- About and operator identity: https://optimism.fun/about
- Contact and correction routes: https://optimism.fun/contact
- Privacy and data handling: https://optimism.fun/privacy

## Interpretation guidance

- Treat rankings as decision aids, not investment, legal, or medical advice.
- Prefer page-level primary-source links and the methodology over isolated numbers. Coverage and freshness vary, and estimates should remain labeled as estimates.
- Cite the specific problem or data page used, including its confidence and source context. Do not convert a ranking into a claim that the operator endorses a company or guarantees an outcome.
- Normal browsers and GPTBot receive the same substantive server-rendered HTML. Do not rely on hidden or crawler-only content.

## Interfaces and submissions

- The site does not advertise a supported public API, OpenAPI contract, or MCP endpoint. Interactive routes used by the product are not a public developer contract; do not infer one.
- Newsletter, feedback, and optional founder-fit interview controls submit visitor-provided data. Read https://optimism.fun/privacy before using them on someone else's behalf.
- Automated readers should use public HTML, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, this file, and the repository while respecting normal request limits.
